title: 信息日报 2026-08-08

headline.title: OpenAI 误攻 Hugging Face 事件时间线公布
headline.summary: OpenAI 在 Black Hat 安全大会上临时演示了“Hugging Face 事件”，随后发布的视频详细披露了事件经过及 OpenAI 内部应对过程。信息密度很高，揭示了这次意外如何发生、影响如何扩散，以及 OpenAI 如何补救。开发者社区由此再次聚焦 AI 供应链安全与平台间信任问题。
headline.title_en: Now we have a timeline of the OpenAI accidental attack against Hugging Face
headline.summary_en: In a last-minute Black Hat session, OpenAI presented 'the Hugging Face Incident'; the video, published yesterday, is information-dense and provides a full timeline of the accidental attack, its spread, and OpenAI's internal response. The disclosure has renewed developer-community concerns about AI supply-chain security and trust between platforms.
headline.original_title: Now we have a timeline of the OpenAI accidental attack against Hugging Face
headline.reason: 该事件是当天最具新闻性的 AI 安全议题，直接影响开发者平台信任与供应链安全，细节首次完整披露，建议作为阅读起点。
headline.reason_en: This is the day's most significant AI security story, affecting developer trust and supply-chain resilience. The full timeline has now come to light, making it the natural starting point for readers.
